hot_issues.title: 插件列表用瀑布流参差不齐，边界不明显，看的眼花
插件卡片上直接显示「它要什么能力」—— 只陈列事实，让用户自己判断
[Bug] remove 之后进程被终止：插件从 profile 消失，且没有 update/uninstall/brokenPlugins 记录可查
【桌面端启动故障】安装 dshmarket 1.66.2 后无法启动，提示 Web RPC failed
[Bug][Desktop] 自更新会把 dshmarket 自己卸载掉：removeBundle 后 installBundle 未执行，市场从 profile 消失（1.66.33 / 1.66.34 实证）
支持已安装插件从旧 npm 包名迁移更新到新包名（evo-subagent → dsh-evo-subagent）
[Bug][Desktop] 一次失败的插件更新把 profile 的 node_modules 清空且未回滚：121 个包变 0，全机能力失效（dshmarket 1.71.1 / DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2）
[Bug][Desktop] 安装/卸载插件时市场自己被卸载：路由 404 或后续永久 409（DSH 0.2.1-rc.4 / 0.2.2-alpha.2）

detail.readme_excerpt: # dsh-market English | [中文](README.zh.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dshmarket)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dshmarket) [![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/dsh-market/dsh-market?style=flat)](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) The plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness. On dsh 0.2.1+ it is a tab on the **Plugins** page, right next to **Installed**; on older hosts open Settings → **Plugin Market**. Browse, search, one-click install. > 📡 **The same catalog is also a plugin market index.** On dsh 0.2.1+, open **Plugins → Discover → Index sources** and add `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-plugin-catalog/index.json`. That is this list as a format-1 index, served from npm so it loads quickly everywhere — dsh gives a source 15 seconds, and the GitHub Pages copies (`https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/index.json` and `https://dshmarket.com/index.json`) can exceed that from some networks. The host's Discover tab and the `plugin_market` agent tool then search it. ![dsh-market](assets/demo-en.png) One-click themes: install, switch live, no restart. ## Install - **Official DSH Desktop:** Open **Settings → Plugins** in the app, search for `dshmarket`, and install it through the app's plugin manager. No command line is needed. - **Regular `dsh web`:** Run this command, then restart `dsh web`: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket ``` - **Custom profile:** Replace `web` in that command with your host's actual profile name: `dsh plugin --profile add dshmarket`. Follow your host's restart instructions. - **From the GitHub source (no build):** `add github:dsh-market/dsh-market` makes pnpm ask before running the package's build scripts. The prebuilt tarball attached to the same release installs without that step: ```sh dsh plugin --profile add https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market/releases/download/v/dshmarket-.tgz ``` On a machine with DSH Desktop, running `dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket` may report success but installs the market into `profiles/web`, **not** the profile used by the Desktop app. It will not appear in Desktop. Install through the app's **Settings → Plugins** instead; Desktop's profile is managed by the app. Once it is installed, open the **Plugins** page and pick the **Plugin Market** tab next to **Installed** (dsh 0.2.1 and newer — plain `dsh web` included, no desktop app needed). The market is also still a section of **Settings → Plugin Market**: on dsh 0.2.0 and older that is the only way in, and from 0.2.1 the Settings dialog lives in the account menu. If you would rather reach it in one click from anywhere, the market can also put its own **Plugin Market** row in the sidebar; turn it on from the market's card under **Plugins**.
